verified.detail: Re-checked: the log, evidence and code commit still match the receipt.

archival.label: Archival record (not re-verified)
archival.detail: The log still matches the receipt byte for byte, but it was not re-verified.

unverifiedArchival.label: Unverified archival
unverifiedArchival.detail: The record is intact, but its rules or outputs cannot be reproduced and nothing vouches for it, so it does not prove the run was completed.

stale.label: Stale
stale.detail: The run log, its evidence or the code changed after this receipt was written, so it no longer proves the run was completed.

unconfirmed.label: Proof not confirmed
unconfirmed.detail: The receipt could not be checked, so this run is not shown as finalized.

checking.label: Checking proof
checking.detail: The receipt is being checked against the run log, its evidence and the code. This takes a moment.

invalid.label: Receipt no longer counts
invalid.detail: A finalize receipt exists but no longer counts: {reason}.

none.label: Not finalized
none.detail: No finalize receipt exists for this run.

wizard.title: Connect Discord
wizard.subtitle: Two clicks happen on Discord's own site; everything else happens right here.

server.title: Make your own Discord server
server.copy: Open Discord and create a new server of your own — this is the server the bot will join. A name is all it needs; it takes a few seconds.

bot.title: Make the bot
bot.copy: In the Developer Portal: click {newApp}, give it a name, open the {bot} page and click {reset}.
bot.copy2: Copy the value it shows, then turn on {intent} on that same page (the bot cannot read messages without it).

key.title: Paste the token
key.label: Bot token
key.hint: Sent straight to your own local gateway and saved there — never shown again after this.
key.paste: Paste the token you copied in step 2
key.saveFailed: The gateway could not save this token.
key.installing: Installing the Discord bot's software — this only happens once, and can take about a minute…
key.installFailed: The Discord bot’s software could not be installed automatically.

invite.title: Get the bot into your server
invite.pick: This bot is already in {count} servers — pick the one you just made:
invite.pickFailed: The gateway could not save this choice.
invite.copy: Click below, pick the server you made in step 1, then click Discord's own {authorise} button on the page that opens — that last click has to be yours; nothing can do it for you.
invite.waitLogin: Waiting for the bot to log in…
invite.waitServer: Waiting for the bot to report which server it is in…

done.title: Done
done.channels: Channels are set up under {category}. A welcome message is posted in {channel} the first time this connects.
done.waitSetup: Waiting for the bot to report that setup is finished…

limit.server: Forge can't create the server for you — a bot that creates its own server automatically owns it, which would not really be yours to control.
limit.bot: The bot itself has to be made on Discord's own site — there is no API for that step.

discord.notInstalled: Discord service is not installed in this project
discord.notInstalledDetail: No Discord bot service was found for this project. Nothing here is running, and nothing can be started yet.
discord.actionFailed: The gateway could not complete this request.

transport.mock: Test transport — no real Discord connection is made.
transport.live: Live transport — genuinely connected to Discord.

auto.saveError: Forge {error}, so after a restart the bot follows your previous choice. Use the switch once more to save it.
auto.settingOff: Turned off in Settings ("discord-autostart"). Turn it on there to have the bot start by itself.
auto.desiredStopped: You switched the bot off, so it stays off after a restart. Switch it on and it comes back by itself.
auto.settingUnknown: Forge's settings could not be read right now, so the bot does not start by itself (the safe choice). This clears up as soon as the settings can be read again.
auto.envOptOut: Automatic start is turned off for this Command Center process (CC_DISCORD_AUTOSTART=off), usually a test or temporary copy.
auto.desiredInvalid: Your last on/off choice could not be read{note}, so the bot does not start by itself. Switch it on here to start it and save your choice again.
auto.notReady: It will start by itself once it can: {reason}. Finish connecting Discord first.
auto.notReadyReason: Discord is not set up yet
auto.conflict: Another program already answers on the bot's port, so the Command Center will not start a second bot: {conflict}. Once that program is gone, the bot starts by itself at the next Command Center start.
auto.notEffective: The gateway says the bot will not start by itself.
auto.lastFailed: The bot is set to start by itself, but the last automatic start failed: {detail}. It tries again at the next Command Center start.
auto.on: The bot starts by itself whenever the Command Center starts, also after a reboot. Switch it off here and it stays off.

service.title: Service
service.subtitle: A real on/off switch — the switch itself only flips once the next status poll confirms it.
service.statusHint: From the gateway's own live status check.

env.title: Environment keys
env.subtitle: Names and presence only — a value is never shown here.

health.title: Bot health
health.subtitle: What the bot's own health check reports, in plain words. Hover a label to see the raw field name.
health.unreachable: Bot not reachable — it may be stopped or still starting.
health.emptyReport: The bot answered with an empty health report.

bot.title: Bot activity
bot.subtitle: What the Discord bot has done on this machine: its jobs, and the cost Claude Code recorded for them.
bot.costHint: Claude Code's own cost figure for each job. On a Claude subscription it estimates usage your plan covers; with an API key it is what was billed.
bot.tokensCache: {amount} of the input was read from the prompt cache.
bot.emptyDetail: The bot has not handled a job on this machine yet. Its jobs and their recorded cost will appear here after the first one.

dir.title: Projects folder
dir.subtitle: Every subfolder in this location automatically becomes a Discord project channel. The bot also keeps a short history file (FORGE_GESCHIEDENIS.txt) in each of those project folders, so it remembers earlier conversations.
dir.sourceDefault: The default location — nothing chosen yet.
dir.notExists: This folder does not exist yet.
dir.unreadable: Could not read this folder right now.
dir.truncated: {count}+ project folders found (there may be more — this folder is very large).
dir.none: No project folders in here yet.
dir.restarted: Saved — the bot restarted and channels are being made for each project folder.
dir.restartFailed: Saved, but the bot could not restart automatically: {error}
dir.savedLater: Saved. This folder will be used the next time the bot starts.
dir.saveFailed: The gateway could not save this folder.
dir.modalDetail: Pick an existing folder, or type a path for advanced use.
dir.partial: This folder is very large — showing only part of the list.
dir.typedHint: For advanced use — the folder can be created for you if it does not exist yet.
dir.create: Create this folder if it doesn't exist yet

activity.runsTruncated: Showing part of this project's runs — there are more than this list can show.

empty.none: No events have been recorded yet.
empty.widenOne: {count} event recorded. Widen a filter or clear the search to see them.
empty.widenMany: {count} events recorded. Widen a filter or clear the search to see them.

activity.noRunRecord: No run record is loaded for this event.
activity.truncated: History truncated — earlier events are no longer available
activity.scanError: Event log unreadable — event count may be understated
activity.feedLive: This feed updates live as new events arrive from the gateway.
activity.feedSample: Timestamps and agent names are example records. The feed does not update — there is nothing connected to update it.
activity.sampleDetail: Local example events. Nothing is streaming, no log was read and no agent emitted these lines.

recovery.title: Recovery & checkpoints
recovery.noFinal: No final status recorded on this attempt.
recovery.noDataDetail: No project is selected, or the gateway has not answered yet.
recovery.notConfiguredDetail: This project has no recovery-attempts.jsonl file under .claude/forge-research.
recovery.emptyDetail: The recovery ledger exists but currently holds nothing.
recovery.noManifestsDetail: No run under this project has recorded a manifest.json yet.

theme.title: Theme
theme.lede: The v1.0 tokens, live. Blued steel and one spark: calm mineral greys and Pauw as the only accent.
theme.markNote: Below 20 px the mark turns one colour: the ember is too small to read.
theme.colourNote: Neutrals carry about 90 % of every screen. Pauw marks where you can act.
theme.typeNote: Bahnschrift for display, Segoe UI Variable for everything else. Mono only for paths, commands and ids.
theme.struckNote: The struck corner is for four things only: the mark, the composer, send and the proof stamp.
theme.tabAfter: to walk the controls: one focus ring everywhere, a canvas gap and a Pauw line.
theme.motionNote: Only transform and opacity move. Under reduced motion every duration is 0.

details.noProof: No proof entries have been recorded for this task.
details.proofNotInExample: {count} recorded, none of them in the example ledger.
details.noTaskExample: No task assigned in the example data.
details.exampleDiffHint: Hand-written diff text. Nothing was read from disk — the prototype has no filesystem access.
details.changeHint: The exact strings the CLI reported for this edit — what it replaced, and what it replaced it with. No diff algorithm was run and nothing was read from disk. Long text is capped by the gateway at capture time.
details.changeOmitted: This edit is real, but its before/after text was left out of this response: the diff budget was already spent by earlier edits. Nothing was truncated — the text is absent, not shortened.
details.changeOmittedChars: This edit is real, but its before/after text was left out of this response: the diff budget ({chars} characters) was already spent by earlier edits. Nothing was truncated — the text is absent, not shortened.
details.changeNone: No diff was recorded for this edit — the change is real, but no before/after text was captured for it (runs recorded before diff capture existed have none). This is an absence of evidence, not evidence that nothing changed.
details.previewLive: A summary recorded with this artifact by the run that produced it — not a live file read.
details.previewExample: Written example content. No file was produced and nothing was rendered.
details.commandLive: Recorded as text from the run that reported it. It is never executed from this panel.
details.commandExample: Recorded as text in the example ledger. It was never executed here.

statusInfo.running: Running — work is in progress right now.
statusInfo.waiting: Waiting — queued behind an earlier step.
statusInfo.verify: Verifying — the claim is being checked against its evidence.
statusInfo.review: In review — awaiting a review pass before it can be accepted.
statusInfo.failed: Failed — stopped with an error and needs attention.
statusInfo.idle: Idle — nothing is running or recorded here right now.
statusInfo.blocked: Blocked — cannot proceed until something else clears.
